name: Chicken Scampi
ingredients: 500g boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1/2 tsp red chili powder (adjust to taste)
instructions: 1. Season chicken pieces with salt and a pinch of turmeric. Set aside for 10 minutes.
2. In a large skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
3. Add sliced onions and cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
4. Stir in ginger paste, red chili powder, turmeric, and garam masala. Cook for 1 minute until spices bloom.
5. Add chicken pieces and sear until golden on all sides, about 5 minutes.
6. Lower heat, pour in heavy cream, and stir gently. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
7. Finish with fresh lemon juice and garnish with cilantro. Serve hot with naan or steamed rice.
description: A buttery, garlic-kissed symphony of succulent chicken and aromatic spices, echoing the lush fields of Punjab.
